gcad_activate_document.description: Make a registered document the active GstarCAD document. Idempotent.
gcad_activate_document.name: gcad_activate_document
gcad_activate_document.title: Activate a document

gcad_apply_actions.description: Primary tool for complex deterministic edits. Prevalidates every action, checks permission and revision, executes sequentially in the COM actor, and reports exact per-action outcomes. Mutating and potentially destructive depending on the batch; atomicity is reported honestly (transaction_mode), never assumed.
gcad_apply_actions.name: gcad_apply_actions
gcad_apply_actions.title: Apply a batch of typed actions

gcad_begin_run.description: Start an auditable drawing run: creates the run directory, manifest, and brief. Idempotent by operation_id.
gcad_begin_run.name: gcad_begin_run
gcad_begin_run.title: Begin an evidence run

gcad_capture_before_state.description: Persist the initial structural entity inventory (and optional 'before' screenshot) for a run. Idempotent unless replace=true.
gcad_capture_before_state.name: gcad_capture_before_state
gcad_capture_before_state.title: Capture before-state evidence

gcad_capture_view.description: Capture the requested document's viewport as PNG evidence. Activates the document and zooms to extents by default. Returns a resource URI; blank/uniform captures are flagged.
gcad_capture_view.name: gcad_capture_view
gcad_capture_view.title: Capture a viewport screenshot

gcad_close_document.description: Close a server-owned document. External documents are denied by default. save_policy 'discard' is destructive.
gcad_close_document.name: gcad_close_document
gcad_close_document.title: Close a server-owned document

gcad_collect_evidence.description: Collect the current entity inventory, document summary, and a review screenshot for a run.
gcad_collect_evidence.name: gcad_collect_evidence
gcad_collect_evidence.title: Collect after-state evidence

gcad_create_entities.description: Create a list of supported entities in one batch. Internally executed through the same action engine as gcad_apply_actions. Idempotent by operation_id.
gcad_create_entities.name: gcad_create_entities
gcad_create_entities.title: Create entities

gcad_ensure_layers.description: Create or update several layers in one call. Mutating but non-destructive and idempotent for identical specs.
gcad_ensure_layers.name: gcad_ensure_layers
gcad_ensure_layers.title: Ensure layers exist

gcad_finalize_run.description: Save the deliverable, capture final evidence, validate, and write the final manifest/feedback. Missing evidence yields partial, never full success. Idempotent by operation_id.
gcad_finalize_run.name: gcad_finalize_run
gcad_finalize_run.title: Finalize a run

gcad_get_entities.description: Fetch richer details for known entity handles. Missing handles are reported in missing_handles rather than as an error.
gcad_get_entities.name: gcad_get_entities
gcad_get_entities.title: Get entities by handle

gcad_get_run_status.description: Return current run state and artifact links without mutation.
gcad_get_run_status.name: gcad_get_run_status
gcad_get_run_status.title: Run status

gcad_get_status.description: Return server, runtime, platform, GstarCAD, protocol, and capability status. Read-only and safe to call first; it works even when GstarCAD startup failed, returning a diagnosis instead of raising.
gcad_get_status.name: gcad_get_status
gcad_get_status.title: GstarCAD server status

gcad_list_documents.description: List registered open GstarCAD documents with server document ids, ownership, revisions, and the active document. Read-only.
gcad_list_documents.name: gcad_list_documents
gcad_list_documents.title: List open documents

gcad_list_layers.description: List normalized layer metadata (name, color, linetype, flags) for one document.
gcad_list_layers.name: gcad_list_layers
gcad_list_layers.title: List layers

gcad_list_layouts.description: List model/paper layouts in tab order for one document.
gcad_list_layouts.name: gcad_list_layouts
gcad_list_layouts.title: List layouts

gcad_new_document.description: Create a new server-owned GstarCAD drawing, optionally from a workspace template. Idempotent by operation_id.
gcad_new_document.name: gcad_new_document
gcad_new_document.title: Create a new drawing

gcad_open_document.description: Open an existing DWG/DXF from the workspace inputs. Idempotent by operation_id; reopening the same canonical path returns the registered document.
gcad_open_document.name: gcad_open_document
gcad_open_document.title: Open a drawing from the workspace

gcad_query_entities.description: Read normalized entity summaries from one registered document with filtering and pagination. Use next_cursor to page large drawings. Does not modify geometry.
gcad_query_entities.name: gcad_query_entities
gcad_query_entities.title: Query entities

gcad_save_document.description: Save a document in place or to a workspace-relative output path (save_as). Saving external documents in place is profile-restricted; overwrite is destructive.
gcad_save_document.name: gcad_save_document
gcad_save_document.title: Save a document

gcad_validate_run.description: Run deterministic structural validation against the run's evidence (inventories, screenshot, save state, journal). Does not claim semantic visual correctness.
gcad_validate_run.name: gcad_validate_run
gcad_validate_run.title: Validate run evidence
